messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert: sudden spike in 5xx rate on control-api-gateway starting ~16:02 UTC. 5xx rate up from 0.6% -> 6.3% over 5m. Top error: upstream 502/504. Paging oncall.
oncall-tilly: acked. I'm on it, paging SRE and the runtime owners. Who's around? :eyes:
sre-jordan: I'm awake, looking. Can someone post a quick top-line from gateway logs and recent deploys? Also any config pushes in the last 15m?
eng-maya: seeing consistent timeouts to org-lookup and billing-service in the gateway logs. snippet: ```[16:03:12] proxy: upstream timeout for /orgs/lookup (504) from 10.120.4.23```
eng-maya: curl to org-lookup from control plane pod returns timeout: ```curl -svS http://org-lookup.internal/v1/lookup?id=123 -m 5``` -> hangs, then HTTP 504
infra-bot: recent config change detected: feature flag 'org_cache_v2' toggled to enabled at 15:58 UTC by eng-raj via config-store. No other deployments in timeframe.
eng-raj: I flipped org_cache_v2 to enabled as part of the rollout for cache refactor. It passed unit tests but we saw a small canary yesterday. Rolling forward today.
sre-jordan: that flag is suspect. If org-lookup backend is mis-handling the new cache TTLs it could cause backend saturation and timeouts -> gateway 5xx. Can we flip flag back to disabled to test?
oncall-tilly: on it. eng-raj can you confirm how to toggle quickly? I don't want to do it from the UI if there's a cli shorter path.
eng-raj: run: ```redwoodctl feature set org_cache_v2 false --env production --actor oncall-tilly``` I'm good to flip if you want me to.
oncall-tilly: doing the flip now.
eng-raj: confirmed: flag set to false at 16:08:34 UTC. Propagation to all proxies should be <30s.
eng-maya: watching metrics... 5xx count dropping at 16:09. still a tail but improving. Sending more logs.
cs-luke: customer impact check: ~3.1% of requests hit 5xx in the 16:02-16:10 window. Top affected endpoints: /v1/control/orgs, /v1/billing/charge. A handful of large customers saw spikes in errors; CS teams notified key accounts.
pm-ana: thanks. Any idea if any persisted data loss or just elevated errors? We need an external comms decision if >5% or major customers impacted.
eng-maya: nothing indicating data loss. Errors are timeouts and transient 504s; retries are recovering for most flows.
sre-jordan: additional mitigation: enable fallback cache in control-api for org lookups (local in-memory cache) while we validate backend. Command: ```kubectl exec -c control-api -n prod control-api-xyz -- /bin/sh -c 'SVC_FALLBACK_CACHE=on ./bin/control-api'``` — we can toggle via config map but this is quick.
oncall-tilly: did that fallback in the canary pod; traffic shows reduced tail latency.
infra-bot: autoscaler triggered at 16:11 to add 2 replicas to org-lookup cluster due to CPU spike.
eng-raj: rolling back the canary code that accompanied org_cache_v2 earlier today to be safe. Initiated rollback at 16:13.
sre-jordan: good. keep watching. Also adding a temporary circuit-breaker directive at the gateway to lower concurrency per upstream to avoid cascading failures: ```gatewayctl set-cb --upstream org-lookup --concurrency 50```
oncall-tilly: circuit-breaker applied at 16:14.
eng-maya: metrics look much better by 16:16: 5xx down to ~0.9%. Latency improved from p95 980ms -> 220ms.
pm-ana: thanks team. CS: keep monitoring for customer escalations. We'll hold comms unless we cross 5% for 15m or key customer downtime.
cs-luke: acknowledged. Notifying two affected enterprise customers with a brief note: "We're investigating transient errors; mitigation under way. We'll update in 30m." :envelope:
sre-jordan: quick summary for handoff: root likely misbehaviour in org_cache_v2 interacting with TTL eviction -> backend saturation and billing downstream timeouts. Immediate mitigations: disabled flag, enabled local fallback cache, applied gateway circuit-breaker, scaled org-lookup replicas, rolled back related canary code. Error rate back near baseline.
oncall-tilly: creating incident ticket: INC-2026 - 'org_cache_v2 rollout caused upstream 504 cascade' and linking logs + timeline.
oncall-mika: taking follow-up oncall at 16:26 UTC — ping me if anything regresses. I'll own the next hour and coordinate postmortem.
oncall-tilly: handing off. Key action items for oncall-mika: 1) validate the rollback fully across regions, 2) confirm no residual feature flags enabled, 3) coordinate postmortem and RCA owners (eng-raj, eng-maya, sre-jordan).
oncall-mika: got it, thanks. I'll also ensure a test harness is added to catch TTL misconfig regressions in the future. Assigning follow-ups to eng-raj and eng-maya.
incident-bot: Note: incident has been updated. Pager resolved for oncall-tilly at 16:28 UTC. If error rate rises above 2% again, pager will re-open.
eng-raj: opening a PR with a safer rollout plan for org_cache_v2 (gradual ramp + circuit-breaker prechecks) and a dashboard to monitor cache eviction rates.
pm-ana: please include a customer-facing blameless summary after RCA is done. Good job getting this back quickly. :thumbsup:
cs-luke: logging this update in the customer incidents tracker and adding the messages we sent.
sre-jordan: leaving this thread but watching the incident ticket. We'll draft a postmortem template and assign next steps.
eng-maya: final note: no data corruption found. keep the rollback until we have a validated plan. I'll start a reproducible test in staging for the cache behavior.
oncall-mika: closing the active handoff. Will post a 1-hour status update and schedule RCA meeting. Thanks everyone. :heart:
